title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Motorcyclists Specification
qco_details: Mandatory Quality Control Order in effect since June 1, 2021. Selling non-ISI helmets is illegal and subject to seizure.
description: Specifies materials, performance, impact absorption, chin strap strength, and peripheral vision requirements for helmets used by two-wheeler riders in India.
application_steps: 1. Register manufacturing unit on Manakonline portal (manakonline.in)
2. Select IS 4151:2015 and pay initial application fee of ₹1,000
3. Set up in-house testing facility for impact absorption & penetration resistance
4. Submit factory layout, machinery details, and QC personnel certificates
5. BIS official carries out physical factory inspection & draws samples
6. Samples tested at BIS recognized laboratory
7. Grant of license upon passing test reports (~30-45 days)
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Inspection fee: ₹7,000/day | Marking fee: ₹15 to ₹25 per 1,000 units | License renewal: ₹1,000 annual

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) Specification
qco_details: Mandatory under FSSAI & BIS Quality Control Regulations. Non-compliant units are subject to immediate closure.
description: Covers physical, chemical, microbiological, radiological, and toxicological parameters for packaged drinking water filled in sealed containers.
application_steps: 1. Ensure plant infrastructure has RO, UV sterilization, ozonation & clean filling line
2. Setup fully equipped micro-biology and chemical testing lab at plant
3. Apply online via Manakonline portal under IS 14543
4. BIS audit of plant hygiene, water source report & manufacturing machinery
5. Draw water samples for 30-day comprehensive chemical & microbiological testing
6. License granted upon satisfactory lab test reports
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Marking fee: ₹87 per 1,000 litres packaged water | Renewal: Annual

title: Drinking Water Specification
qco_details: Benchmark standard used by municipal bodies, water purifiers, and packaged water plants across India.
description: Defines acceptable and permissible limits for 60+ parameters including pH, total dissolved solids (TDS), turbidity, heavy metals (Lead, Arsenic), nitrates, and coliform bacteria.
application_steps: 1. Apply via Manakonline for voluntary or municipal conformity certification
2. Submit lab test reports for all 60 parameters
3. BIS verification of water treatment process
fees_structure: Standard application & marking fee based on production capacity

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Specification
qco_details: Mandatory QCO issued by DPIIT. It is illegal to manufacture, import, or sell non-ISI pressure cookers in India.
description: Specifies design, bursting pressure, thermal efficiency, safety valves, operating pressure, and material specifications (Aluminum / Stainless Steel) for domestic pressure cookers.
application_steps: 1. Ensure in-house pressure testing rig and safety valve calibration tools
2. File application on Manakonline under IS 2347:2017
3. Factory inspection by BIS scientific officer
4. Hydrostatic pressure testing of cooker bodies and rubber gaskets
5. Grant of CML (Certificate of Manufacturing License)
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Marking fee: ₹5 per unit | Inspection fee: Standard daily rate

title: Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
qco_details: Toys Quality Control Order makes ISI marking compulsory for all electric and non-electric toys manufactured or imported into India.
description: Covers safety parameters preventing sharp edges, small parts (choking hazard), toxic paint, flammable materials, and heavy metals in children's toys.
application_steps: 1. Identify toy category (electric or non-electric)
2. Set up safety testing equipment (drop test, pull test, sharp edge tester)
3. Submit application on Manakonline portal
4. BIS inspection of manufacturing process & paint source certification
5. Chemical toxicity testing at BIS-recognized laboratory
6. Grant of ISI mark license
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Concessional marking fee for MSMEs (50% discount available)

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Safety Requirements
qco_details: Mandatory under Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) administered by MeitY and BIS.
description: Covers insulation resistance, electric shock protection, heat resistance, ingress protection, and fire resistance for LED bulbs used in homes and offices.
application_steps: 1. Get product tested in a BIS-recognized NABL laboratory
2. Obtain valid Test Report (valid for 90 days)
3. Register account on CRS portal (crsbis.in)
4. Upload test report, brand authorization letter, and factory details
5. BIS issues Registration Number (R-xxxxxxx)
6. Print Standard Mark with R-Number on LED lamp packaging
fees_structure: Registration fee: ₹53,000 for main model + inclusion fee for series models

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
qco_details: Mandatory under MeitY CRS scheme for laptops, mobile phones, power adapters, printers, and monitors.
description: Ensures electrical, thermal, energy, and mechanical safety for IT products to prevent electric shocks, battery fires, and user injuries.
application_steps: 1. Test IT equipment sample at BIS-approved lab
2. Submit CRS application on crsbis.in portal
3. Foreign manufacturers must nominate an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR)
4. Automatic verification of lab test report by BIS portal
5. Instant grant of CRS Registration Number
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹53,000 per model family | Renewal every 2 years

title: General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres
qco_details: Mandatory Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Artefacts Order in 350+ districts across India.
description: Governs registration of jewellers and authorization of Assaying & Hallmarking (A&HC) centres to apply 6-digit HUID (Hallmark Unique ID) on gold items (14K, 18K, 20K, 22K, 23K, 24K).
application_steps: 1. Jeweller registers on Manakonline portal (manakonline.in)
2. Upload GST certificate, PAN, and business address proof
3. Registration is instantly granted online with lifetime validity and zero fee
4. Send gold jewellery to BIS recognized A&HC centre for XRF testing & HUID laser etching
fees_structure: Jeweller Registration: FREE (Zero fee) | Hallmarking charge: ₹45 per gold article + GST

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (TMT Bars)
qco_details: Mandatory Quality Control Order by Ministry of Steel. Selling uncertified TMT bars is a criminal offense.
description: Specifies chemical composition, yield stress, tensile strength, elongation, and bend test requirements for Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600 grade TMT steel bars used in building construction.
application_steps: 1. Setup steel testing equipment (Universal Testing Machine, spectrometer)
2. File application on Manakonline
3. Factory audit by BIS scientific inspection team
4. Mechanical & chemical testing of steel billets and rolled TMT bars
5. Grant of CML license
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Marking fee based on metric tonnage produced

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
qco_details: Mandatory certification under Cement Quality Control Order.
description: Covers physical and chemical requirements for 33 grade, 43 grade, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) including compressive strength, setting time, and soundness.
application_steps: 1. Maintain in-house chemical & physical testing lab
2. Apply via Manakonline
3. BIS physical factory inspection & sample collection
4. 28-day compressive strength lab test
5. Issue of ISI License
fees_structure: Application fee: ₹1,000 | Marking fee: Per metric tonne produced
